BEFORE YOU START
1
Go to SCAN tab. Tap the upload banner and select today's mlbarod_det Excel file from Ramco. The app will append new records to any existing data — it will not overwrite unless you confirm. You will see the record count once loaded.
2
Your machine is pre-assigned as TE-01. If wrong, tap CHANGE and select the correct machine. Do this before scanning — the machine name is captured at scan time.
3
This app runs in Chrome browser on your phone. Camera access is required — allow it when prompted.
!
Refreshing the page clears all session data. CLEAR SESSION button resets the active scan state only — the scan log is kept and is NOT cleared (whether to clear logs in production will depend on database storage capacity, decided separately).
SCANNING
▣
Tap SCAN QR. Point the camera at the lower QR code on the MRP sticker. Hold steady — it scans automatically. The item details appear with SAVE and CANCEL buttons — nothing is recorded until you tap SAVE.
◷ BLUE — Match found. Review details, then tap SAVE to record or CANCEL to discard.
⚠ ORANGE — Duplicate. Already scanned. Tap FLAG ERROR if this is wrong, or DISMISS.
✕ RED — Not in today's upload. Scan logged for review. Tap FLAG ERROR if needed, or DISMISS.
CAMERA NOT WORKING?
1
Check Chrome has camera permission — go to Chrome Settings → Site Settings → Camera and allow this page.
2
Try closing and reopening Chrome, then reload the page.
3
If camera still fails — use the manual entry field below the SCAN button. Type or paste the Item SI No and tap GO. This is functionally identical to scanning.
!
Camera requires the page to be served over HTTPS or localhost. If opening directly from a file (file://), camera will be blocked by the browser. Ask IT to host the file on IIS.
HOW BRAND & VARIETY ARE DETERMINED
?
Brand and Variety are looked up automatically from the Item Code prefix against a master mapping table (102 entries, supplied by PEPS). The longest matching prefix wins — e.g. RTHTMTPKRG matches before the shorter RT. No manual input needed.
?
Three brands in the current mapping: Peps Spring, Vista Bond, Cirrus Foam. Any Item Code not found in the mapping table shows as Unknown — this is intentional, so gaps in the mapping table are visible and can be corrected rather than guessed.
SAVE / CANCEL ON SCAN
◷
After a successful scan or manual entry, the item details appear with SAVE and CANCEL buttons. Nothing is recorded until you tap SAVE. A popup confirms "Data saved successfully" and the cursor returns to the manual entry field for the next scan.
◷
Tap CANCEL to discard a scan without saving — useful if the wrong item is shown before it's recorded.
WRONG SCAN / ERRORS
!
If a mistake is found after saving — tap FLAG ERROR on the result card. Add a short note. Record is marked for supervisor review. Do not scan again.
!
Only a supervisor can remove or correct a flagged scan. The log must stay complete.
WHAT TO TEST
→
Upload today's Excel file — confirm record count matches expectation.
→
Upload a second file — confirm records are appended, not replaced. Try a file with a duplicate SI No inside it — confirm it's blocked and reported, while valid rows still load.
→
Scan a valid sticker — expect BLUE confirm card with Variety and Brand shown. Tap SAVE — expect "Data saved successfully" popup and cursor back in the input field.
→
Scan a valid sticker and tap CANCEL — confirm nothing is recorded in LOG.
→
Scan same sticker again after saving — expect ORANGE duplicate block.
→
Change machine, scan and SAVE again — confirm new machine name appears correctly in LOG and BOARD.
→
Check that Brand and Variety shown match the mapping table — flag any Item Code showing as "Unknown" so the master table can be updated.
→
Check DASHBOARD tab — confirm hourly, variety, and KPI panels update with your saved scans.
→
Apply filters on DASHBOARD (Shift, Machine, Brand, Variety) — confirm data filters correctly.
KNOWN POC LIMITATIONS
–
Page refresh = all data gone. No server in POC. Re-upload file on every session.
–
Camera requires HTTPS/localhost. Use manual entry if camera is blocked.
–
Operator name per shift is not yet implemented — deferred to next version.
–
Brand/Variety mapping covers 102 known Item Code prefixes. Codes outside this list show as "Unknown" by design — this surfaces gaps for the master table to be corrected, rather than guessing.
